description: Use this to see which rules would match a stored message, and which actions would run or be skipped, without changing mail. Read-only; requires auth and message_read. Inputs: inbox_id (required), message_id (required), and optional name, conditions, actions, and stop_processing. With only message_id, every enabled rule on the inbox is tested in order. With conditions or actions, that unsaved rule is tested and nothing is stored. Returns {object:"inbox_rule_test", message_id, data:[{rule_id, name, matched, actions, skipped, stop_processing}]}. skipped entries look like auto_reply:list. No labels, folder, forward, or reply is written. An unknown message is HTTP 404 message_not_found.

actions.description: Actions for an unsaved rule. Omit to test stored rules.

conditions.description: Conditions for an unsaved rule. Omit to test stored rules.

inbox_id.description: Inbox id (inb_…), username, or full email address owned by this key

message_id.description: Stored message id (msg_…) in this inbox.

name.description: Name for an unsaved rule. Default Preview.

name: cooper_test_rule
title: Test inbox rules
